init_state: initialize a SAM2VideoPredictor inference state by loading video frames from a given video path
propagate_in_video: propagate input points across all video frames to track objects throughout the entire video
add_new_points_or_box: add new point clicks or a bounding box prompt to a specific frame for object segmentation
add_new_mask: add a binary mask input to a specific frame to correct or refine tracked object segmentation
remove_object: remove an object id from the tracking state and update masks for remaining tracked objects
